Hey, I’m Lisa! 👋🏼🤎

Just a Vienna girl with a serious love for good food, cute little cafés, delicious matcha & discovering places that make this city so special! ☕️🍵🥐

When I’m not spending my days in the classroom, you’ll probably find me wandering through Vienna, trying somewhere new for brunch, searching for my next favorite coffee spot or taking way too many pictures along the way. 🏛️📸✨

I’ve always loved exploring beautiful places, tasting delicious food & capturing little everyday moments. So I decided to share it all right here! 🤎

Welcome to my personal Vienna diary – filled with honest restaurant reviews, cozy cafés, matcha recommendations, hidden gems, travel memories & little glimpses into my life.

Nothing overly planned or picture-perfect. Just my genuine love for good food, beautiful places & all the little things that make me happy. 🫶🏼

I’m still finding my way, learning as I go & dreaming big about everything that’s yet to come. 🥹✨

A little bit of Vienna, a little bit of me & a whole lot of adventures waiting to happen!

If you love discovering new restaurants, cute coffee spots & beautiful corners of Vienna, I think you’ll feel right at home here! 👀

Follow wiener.lisa_ and join me for honest food recommendations, delicious discoveries & all the little adventures ahead! 🤎
